source: XP: OSRS Wiki, each spell's page (read 2026-11-10). Levels, runes, the extra item (Ape Atoll's banana) and the magic tab component come from the cache's spell objs. Landing areas (each minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ, inclusive): the Wiki spell pages' maps for Lumbridge (the plus-shaped polygon, as two rectangles), Falador, Ardougne, Trollheim, Ape Atoll, Kourend Castle and Civitas illa Fortis (a square of radius r is the tile plus or minus r; a polygon's corners are tile edges, so its east and north edges are one past the last tile). Inferred: Varrock and Camelot land within 2 tiles of the Wiki's tile, as 2004Scape's teleport script does for every standard teleport. Guessed: Watchtower lands on the Wiki's tile only, on the top floor (level 2). Tablets: the cache's poh_tablet objs for the same places. Kourend Castle Teleport and Civitas illa Fortis Teleport have reused ids, so their gameval names are an old lamp's note and a sack's placeholder (21836 and 24612; the param 601 names are the spells').
